A rich-text editor framework with AI, tables, mentions and 324 installable shadcn/ui parts.

Source: [plate](https://github.com/udecode/plate) by udecode — MIT.

Publishes its own shadcn registry (324 items), so installs come straight from them.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://platejs.org/r/plate.json
```
